text.jp:
おや、本当に来てしまうとは。
正直、一人で向かうつもりだったのだが。
text.official_en:
You actually came? Honestly, I'd intended to head
there on my own.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まあ、いいか。それならば共に
アラゴ迎賓館に忍び込むとしよう。
text.official_en:
It's fine. I suppose we can go together to the
Aragonians' guesthouse.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
なに、見張りなど問題にはならないさ。
さあ、おれについてきてくれ。
text.official_en:
We ought to be fine so long as we merely surveil,
then leave! After me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
姫……それがしは、
少々己が揺らいできておるかもしれませぬ。
text.official_en: Milady, I am beginning to feel uncertain.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これまでは、姫が復讐を果たすことこそが、
未来を切り開く唯一の道であると……
text.official_en:
I've held to the belief that you would see a better
future only by carrying out your revenge.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
姫を呪縛から解き放ち、闇に光明を
見出すための手段だと考えてきました。
text.official_en:
I thought it a way for you to be free from the
burden of your darkness and find the light.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しかし……その考えに少し、
迷いが生まれ始めているかもしれませぬ。
text.official_en: Now, though, I can't help but question that idea.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
姫に対するそれがしの忠義に
微塵の曇りもないのは変わらないのですが……
text.official_en:
Know that my loyalty to you has not been tarnished
in the slightest.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
申し訳ござりませぬ……このバッカニアに、
いましばし考える時間をお与えくだされ。
text.official_en: Apologies... Please allow me some time to think.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダ嬢は確かに、ここのところ、
少し苛立っている様子ではあるな。
text.official_en: You seem to be more on edge, Miss Leda.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
当然、自覚はあるのだろう？
貴女を曇らせているものが何かは詮索せぬが。
text.official_en:
You are aware of this as well, yes? As to what
darkens your mood, I won't pry.

text.jp: <NCA>大きなお世話だ
text.official_en: <NCA>Tell him to mind his own business.

text.jp: <NCB>自覚はある
text.official_en: <NCB>Tell him that he's right.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACA>ほう、そんなことはないと？
ではここからはあくまでおれの独り言だが……
text.official_en:
<ACA>So you won't admit it? In that case, as you say,
I'll mind my own business...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACA>それならば、もう少し苛立ちが
外側に出ぬようにすることだ。
text.official_en:
<ACA>Though if you want fewer inquiries about your mood,
you might at least act less irritable.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACB>気をつけたまえ。君がそのようだと、
仲間たちの間に動揺が広がる。
text.official_en:
<ACB>Try not to show it. If you go along like this, unrest is
sure to crop up among your allies.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACB>人の上に立ち、先頭を歩むものは
時に己の内面を秘めねばならぬのだ。
text.official_en:
<ACB>Unfortunately, those who lead others must at times
conceal their thoughts and feelings.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……レダさん、本当に大丈夫？
なにか、ボクたちに秘密にしてたりしない？
text.official_en:
Are you sure you're OK, Leda? You're not keeping
secrets from the rest of us or something?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だって、ボク、レダさんのことが心配だよ。
最近なんだか悩んでる事が多そうだし。
text.official_en:
I mean...I'm starting to worry. You seem to have a
lot on your mind.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ううん……
ボクの気のせいだったらいいんだけど。
text.official_en: I hope I'm just imagining it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
なんとか……なんとか期限内に、頼まれていた
作曲の仕事を終えることができましたわ……
text.official_en:
Somehow I was able to finish composing the song
in time...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もし遅れていれば、カーラ神殿の
名誉に傷をつけてしまうところでしたわ。
text.official_en:
Had I missed the deadline, it would have been
harmful for the reputation of Kalla's temple.
text.real_en:
Had I missed the deadline, it would have been
harmful for the reputation of Cara's temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
………………
今回は本当に危ないところでしたわ。
text.official_en: It was rather a close call.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
思えばあたくし、あなたのことを意識しすぎて
本来の力が発揮できていなかったのかも……
text.official_en:
I wonder if I was too focused on besting you to tap
into my true potential.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レイリダーナ、
改めて、礼を言っておきますわ。
text.official_en:
In any case, Leilidahna, please allow me to express
my gratitude.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
本当に、今回ばかりはもう駄目かと……
助けてくれて感謝しておりますわ。
text.official_en:
I thought this was the end for me! Thank you for
coming to my rescue.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ

text.jp:
いよいよここから本戦を迎え、
大剣闘祭は本当の戦いが始まるといえる。
text.official_en:
You have made it to the main matches. One might
say the true battles of the Heroic Games are ahead.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
本戦出場者はまさに強豪揃い……
中には、知った顔もいることだろうな。
text.official_en:
The contestants are fearsome competitors...some of
them with faces you'll recognize.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、其方の願いを叶えるためには
避けては通れぬ壁でもある。
text.official_en:
But you must face them if you are to have your
wish granted.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レイリダーナよ、励むがよい。
技を磨き、研鑽を重ねよ。勝つためにな。
text.official_en:
Make every effort, Leilidahna. To win, you must
hone your skills and devote yourself to your studies.
